notes: Yolo is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 YOLO once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It has no administrative or external minting functions and no transfer fees. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs YOLO with IMD at a 1.25% fee. initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
